name: Tile Image Slider
description: Full-screen image slider with a large animated headline, category label, slide counter, progress bar, and an up-next pill button with thumbnail that advances the slide with a crossfade.
contents: Full-bleed background image with dark gradient overlay
Slide counter, category label, and multi-line headline
Up-next pill button with thumbnail, next category, and arrow
behavior: Clicking the pill crossfades and scales to the next image, loops at the end
Headline scrolls up to the next title, pill slides out and springs back
Progress bar refills on each slide
Image is fitted to the container on window resize
editableByProps: Slides: images, thumbnails, alt text, titles (HTML line breaks allowed), categories
Accent color, overlay darkness, pill background and blur
Title size and left offset, animation duration, button labels

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image aspect ratio used for fitting
Change fonts or the pill hover arrow motion

fixed: Slider fills the viewport height (h-screen); override with className
Advances only by clicking the pill button
Loads Space Grotesk and Space Mono from Google Fonts through an @import in STYLES
Assumes images are about 3:2 when fitting
